# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 08 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch Update

- **Thomson Reserve sells 90.1% at launch, all 3- and 4-bedroom units taken up** - Buyers purchased 1,143 of 1,268 homes at an average price of S$2,900 psf, making it the year's best-selling new condominium launch. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/thomson-reserve-launch-sales/)

## HDB Resale — Record Prices Across Multiple Towns

- **Million-dollar HDB resale flats hit a third straight monthly record in October 2026** - A record 238 HDB resale flats changed hands for at least S$1 million in October 2026, up from 209 in September and 201 in August, making up 10.9% of October's total resale volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/million-dollar-hdb-resale-record-october-2026/)
- **Yishun executive flat sets new record at S$1.329M** - A 1,765 sq ft executive flat at Block 652 Yishun Ave 4 sold for $1.329M ($753 psf), a new record even though the unit is 183 sq ft smaller than the previous record holder. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/yishun-executive-flat-crossed-1-3m/)
- **Kallang Trivista 4-room flat sets new Kallang/Whampoa record at S$1.32M** - A 4-room flat at Kallang Trivista sold for $1.32M, setting a new HDB resale price record for the Kallang/Whampoa estate. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/four-room-flat-kallang-trivista-sold/)
- **Tampines executive flat sells for S$1.275M, town's second priciest HDB resale** - An executive flat at Tampines Palmspring changed hands for S$1.275 million, setting a new price record for executive flats in Tampines. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/tampines-palmspring-executive-flat-record-1-275-million/)

## BTO — November 2026 Launch and February 2027 Preview

- **November 2026 BTO: 7,964 flats launched across six towns** - HDB launched 7,964 BTO flats across seven projects in Bedok, Geylang, Sembawang, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun on 4 November — the final BTO exercise of the year and the first under higher income ceilings for families. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-launch-highlights/)
- **February 2027 BTO preview: around 4,300 flats in Bishan, Tampines, Tengah and Toa Payoh** - HDB's next BTO exercise will offer around 4,300 flats across five projects, alongside a Sale of Balance Flats exercise with about 5,000 flats, bringing combined supply to roughly 9,300 homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/february-2027-bto-launch-preview/)
